verdict.rationale: Cactus documents a free tier ($0 local LoRA fine-tuning with the open-source package) and paid platform tiers (Starter, Pro, Custom) for hosted GPUs, full-model training, the confidence head and 2-bit exports. That shows which features are free versus paid, but nothing says whether commercial or enterprise use of the free open-source edition needs a paid license. missing for 10: explicit open-source license terms, a statement on commercial/enterprise use rights for the free edition, enterprise licensing details, independent corroboration
